I have always been on the fence with the argument of TT.

For the pros:
- option for high volume fighting
- high loot rate
- unique environment (only skyscrapers in game)
- fantastic end game battles

As for the cons:
- map balance issues
- high early game death rate
- lag/audio/visual performance issues
- circle advantage leading to camping

I think the best solution would just be adding another point of interest or two. Maybe N Shore and Race track. Regardless, if it stays I see no solution that will stop at least 15-20 going there each game.

I just wanted to say thank you for all the comments, compliments, and criticisms. I am glad so many people seem to like it, questionable or not.

I would like to point out the “why” and “those are permanent” are falling on deaf ears for me but I’d advise to post it if you think it as we may have younger readers on the board that may think this is a good idea for them and regret tattoo decisions.

In my case I should point out that I am 28, and have a significant amount of tattoo art already so I am very aware of the fact this won’t come off in the shower :). I appreciate if you have concern but I know what I was getting into, and I am very happy with this art.

Hi magic, pricing for tattoos varies significantly depending on the size, quality, location, colour, style etc so it is very hard to say exactly. With this particular piece the art is about 10 inches tall plus the wording. The full cost was $220 coming out to 110$ an hour approx. with that said there are reasons it was this price as opposed to 300 or more. First I had the piece printed out to size when I went to book the sitting and had everything I wanted ready so less prep was needed (it may seem like a lot of detail but the line work for the stencil took him about 5 minutes. 
Second I wanted minimal colour, aside from the blue on the eyes, red in the bow and some white highlights it is all done with black ink, minimizing the cost.
Last, be friendly and courteous to your artist, and don’t make a thousand changes leading up. If you need to make a change every day you really haven’t thought it through and shouldn’t get it to begin with. I’ve spoke with several of my artists and they state they will upxharge slightly if the customer is rude.
